Name: Wallet Horse Flute
Author: HeavyStarRuler
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]I was just not that thrilled with carrying around a Horse Flute in a backpack slot everywhere when you clearly have pockets that hold other things, such as your Club Card, Magic Ink, etc. So I moved the Horse Flute to the Special Items & Powers tab (wallet).
[/size]

[size=4]Config Options:
[/size][/font][list]
[*][b][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Enabled:[/font] [/size][font=Courier New][size=4]true [/size][/font][font=Trebuchet MS]or [/font][font=Courier New][size=4]false[/size][/font][/b]
[*][b][font=Trebuchet MS]Hotkey: (default: [/font][font=Courier New][size=4]Q[/size][size=3])[/size][/font][/b]
[/list][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]

[/size][/font][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]If you'd like your flute back before uninstalling the mod (recommended), make sure you have Generic Mod Config Menu installed and change the "Enabled" option for this mod to false or off. That will put a Horse Flute into your inventory (presumably the one taken from you when the Special Item/Power unlocked).

If you have any questions or suggestions, or you're having trouble with things, please reach out. I'd be more than happy to look into what's going on and fix things.[/size][/font]
